service.explanation: Thin-provisioned LUNs return deleted space to the volume only when space reclamation is enabled and the initiator sends UNMAP; thick-provisioned LUNs have their configured capacity allocated up front. VMM virtual disks are stored under @iSCSI/fixtureLUN/fixtureVDISK_*; use Virtual Machine Manager > Virtual Machine to identify their storage. VMM images are managed in Virtual Machine Manager > Image, where their selected storage is shown.
